libbal_v512_exp022base.so:v_walk.constpr.note: production group and walker (v_group inlined into v_walk by the compiler in this build)

vm_group_mask_branch.interpretation: in vm_group the eight digest staging stores and all extraction code sit behind a test of extract_mode and a kortestw of the meets mask, both branching to the exit region: on a group whose mask is zero they never execute, so the miss path performs zero digest stores. The zmm stores before the guard are the inner-state staging (which feeds the outer compression, present in both kernels) plus the compiler's spill of the final state, which the compare consumes from stack slots. Production v_walk has no opmask compare at all: its staging stores and its scalar byte-compare loop over all 16 lanes run unconditionally per group.
